data.description:
## Overview
Create user documentation for the GoT-Causal analysis features.

## File References
- Existing docs: CLAUDE.md (SOPs section)
- Demo script: examples/prism_causal_demo.py
- Behavioral tests: tests/behavioral/test_got_causal_integration.py

## Documentation to Create
1. **Usage Guide** (docs/got-causal-guide.md)
   - Quick start examples
   - CLI command reference
   - Interpreting results

2. **Data Collection Best Practices**
   - Link to CLAUDE.md SOPs
   - Examples of good vs bad data

3. **Causal Concepts Primer**
   - DEPENDS_ON vs CAUSED_BY explained
   - Necessity vs sufficiency
   - Confounders and why they matter

4. **Troubleshooting**
   - "Analysis unreliable" warnings
   - Data quality improvement steps

## Format
- Markdown for docs/
- Examples should be runnable
- Include diagrams for causal concepts

## Acceptance Criteria
- New user can understand causal analysis in 10 minutes
- All CLI commands documented with examples
- Links to deeper resources (Pearl, etc.)
data.title: Document GoT-Causal analysis capabilities
